# TreeBites

> TreeBites food and nutrition catalogue: seeds and seed mixes, kitchen staples, juices and beverages, breakfast and drink mixes, supplements and fibre.

Website: https://tree-bites.com/

This is a brand portfolio and product catalogue. Orders are completed on Amazon or Fashinoworld. Current prices, stock, shipping and returns are determined by the retailer. Product pack sizes are stated on each product page; some Amazon links remain unavailable until the exact pack is confirmed.

## Categories

- [Seeds & seed mixes](https://tree-bites.com/categories/seeds-and-mixes/): A little crunch for breakfast bowls, snacks and everything in between.
- [Kitchen staples](https://tree-bites.com/categories/kitchen-staples/): Nolen gur, ghee and turmeric for the recipes you come back to.
- [Juices & beverages](https://tree-bites.com/categories/juices-and-beverages/): Fruit blends and Bengali-inspired flavours, bottled for your day.
- [Breakfast & drink mixes](https://tree-bites.com/categories/breakfast-and-drink-mixes/): Discover a sattu blend for your daily drink routine.
- [Supplements & fibre](https://tree-bites.com/categories/supplements-and-fibre/): Discover moringa capsules and isabgol. Always follow the product label.

## About TreeBites

Home / Our story OUR STORY · ABOUT TREEBITES Familiar roots. Everyday goodness. TreeBites brings everyday ingredients, Bengali flavours and food discoveries together. From a handful of seeds to a spoonful of nolen gur, our collection belongs in the little rituals that make a day your own. Discover our products A TASTE OF THE FAMILIAR Nolen gur. A little sweetness, a lot of character. In our catalogue 20 products Ways to explore 5 categories Brand contact Kolkata, India GET TO KNOW US The brand Our flavours Our range Product information Where to buy Get in touch 01 / THE BRAND Good food. Everyday moments. A breakfast bowl with a little more crunch. A familiar recipe with its finishing spoonful of ghee. A refreshing pause between the things you do. That is the world of TreeBites: ingredients and flavours you can make part of your own routine. Our food and nutrition collection spans seeds and seed mixes, kitchen staples, juices and beverages, breakfast and drink mixes, and supplements and fibre. Our brand line, “Nourishing roots. Enriching lives.” , sits alongside a collection that brings familiar food traditions and everyday choices into the same place. Browse by ingredient, by category or by the product you already love. 02 / FAMILIAR FLAVOURS A little taste of Bengal. Some flavours feel instantly familiar. Nolen gur is one of them. Our Nolen Gur brings Bengali date palm jaggery to desserts, drinks and favourite recipes. Explore a single jar or the two-pack, depending on what you need in your kitchen. The same flavour appears in a different format in Nolen Gur Coconut Chill , where coconut meets nolen gur in a bottled drink. Alongside these Bengali-inspired products, Pure Ghee and Raw Turmeric make up the rest of our kitchen-staples collection. Explore the kitchen staples 03 / OUR RANGE Five ways to find your kind of good. Get to know what is in the TreeBites collection. 01 Seeds & seed mixes Pumpkin, sunflower, chia and flax seeds, alongside Healthy Mix. Explore individual seeds and a blend of pumpkin, sunflower, flax and sesame for breakfast bowls, salads and everyday recipes. Explore 6 products in Juices & beverages 04 Breakfast & drink mixes Sattu Protein Mix in two pack sizes. Discover the blend, compare the packs and follow the preparation directions on the label. Explore 2 products in Breakfast & drink mixes 05 Supplements & fibre Moringa Capsules, Shilajit Capsules and Isabgol Psyllium Husk. Each product has its own directions and suitability information; refer to its label before use. Explore 3 products in Supplements & fibre 04 / KNOW YOUR PRODUCT The details matter. Packaging and availability may change. Products in our supplements and fibre collection have their own preparation and usage directions. Always follow the instructions and precautions on the pack.
